overlays.title: Sentinel-1 summer 2017: vertical change
overlays.description: Vertical displacement from 20170701 to 20170923 relative to plateau bedrock; slopes > 5 deg masked. At 10-50 km the atmosphere dominates: use it as a pattern map, not for absolute values between distant places.

overlays.title: Where the ground sinks every summer
overlays.description: Local seasonal motion vs ~2 km surroundings, mean of 2020 and 2025 where both summers agree in sign. The reproducible part of the signal: wetlands.
